G.A. 
 Court No. - 12
 Hon'Ble Pankaj Bhatia, J.

1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in S.T. No.916 of 2022 arising out of Case Crime No.121 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 304B, 302, 201 IPC and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station Khodahre, District Gonda.
3.

In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that that the daughter of the informant was married to the applicant on around two years ago and sufficient dowry was given, however, the entire matrimonial family used to harass her and subsequently, killed her and thrown the body in a tank with an intend to conceal it.
Subsequently, the body was recovered and the FIR in question was lodged.
4. The Counsel fro the applicant argues that the applicant himself had lodged a missing person report.
He further argues that subsequently, PW-1 has not supported the prosecution case and the P.W.-1 and P.W.-3 have been declared hostile.
5. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

6. Considering the statements annexed along with the rejoinder affidavit; the fact that major witnesses have not supported the prosecution case; no eyewitness of the incident; the applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 04.08.2022, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.
